strategy.angle: A8-L heavy, swollen legs she hides under long trousers
strategy.mechanism: M1: when the body can't clear everyday oxidative stress, the tissue in the legs stays inflamed and stops draining normally, so fluid sits there — heavy, tender, puffy — and no diet reaches it, because it was never fat; the tablet turns a glass of water into hydrogen-rich water, hydrogen is the smallest molecule there is, reaches the tissue and helps the body switch that process off so normal drainage can resume
strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: summer, skirts, sandals she avoids · cause: inflamed tissue holding fluid · tried: compression socks, elevating, water tablets
strategy.belief_installed: It was never fat. It's fluid my body stopped clearing — and no diet reaches it.

people.customer_look: lower legs only of woman 40–55, soft midlife build, ordinary clothes, visibly swollen heavy calves and ankles (sock marks, puffy ankles) — never a young fitness model

visual_bans: legs only, no torso, no face
sketch stays black on white: no colour except the pouch
the product is only ever a white effervescent tablet in a clear glass of water — no other dosage form, no blister pack, no sachet
no bottle, jar or tub for Edenvia — the container is the stand-up pouch of Image 1, label untouched
any glass holds clear water with fine rising bubbles; never hot water, tea or coffee in that glass
no competitor brand name, logo or bottle shape anywhere (brand.json banned list)
no disease or drug name on the image
compliance_flags: timeline results claim — primary text carries '*Results may vary'
